description: Unit tests for net::string_util functions in the Chromium project, testing string utilities such as ASCII checks, case-insensitive comparisons, suffix/prefix checks, find-and-replace, hex encoding, number to string conversion, and string splitting.

methods.name: IsAscii
methods.description: Tests if a string contains only ASCII characters.

methods.name: EndsWithNoCase
methods.description: Checks if a string ends with a given suffix, case-insensitive.

methods.name: FindAndReplace
methods.description: Replaces all occurrences of a substring with another string.

methods.name: StartsWithNoCase
methods.description: Checks if a string starts with a given prefix, case-insensitive.

methods.name: HexEncode
methods.description: Encodes binary data into a hexadecimal string.

methods.name: NumberToDecimalString
methods.description: Converts a number to its decimal string representation.

methods.name: SplitString
methods.description: Splits a string into a vector of substrings based on a delimiter.
